verdict.rationale: Signifyd's marketing pages explicitly list 'Account Protection' (defend customer accounts) as a product surface alongside checkout-time 'Guaranteed Fraud Protection' and 'Return Insights' for returns/refund abuse, showing risk coverage extends beyond checkout into account takeover and post-purchase abuse. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of fake account creation detection or promo abuse policy scoring, nor detail on how these surfaces share a unified case/decision system with checkout. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on fake-account-creation detection, promo-abuse policy management, and confirmation that account/return/promo signals feed the same case management or decision engine as checkout orders.
